title: Cut The Rope Crashes Due to "NSKeyedArchiver" & "arg.is_null()" Issue
author: kiratmust-bit
body:
Cut The Rope Crashes Due to "NSKeyedArchiver" & "arg.is_null()" Issue

Cut The Rope Version 1.5 (Emulator Version: touchHLE PREWIEW 0.2.2-942-g06e8302)
There are two different reports for this version. In one, the game crashes on due to the missing archiveRootObject:toFile: method of the NSKeyedArchiver class. (However, the game can still be played as long as you don't click on some buttons.) In the other, it crashes with an "assertion failed: arg.is_null()" error when trying to change the game's language settings.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/47c0174b-0622-4b69-95ff-f20cc5348f8d
